mapper.sql: select a.id, a.advance_registration_id, a.print_count, a.print_time, a.min_unit, a.min_unit_name, a.max_unit, a.max_unit_name, a.convert_count, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.del_flag from t_material_detail_print a
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.advance_registration_id, a.print_count, a.print_time, a.min_unit, a.min_unit_name, a.max_unit, a.max_unit_name, a.convert_count, a.create_time,a.sum_count,a.rfid_heads,a.print_type, b.material_id , b.detection_count, b.batch_code , c.code as advanceDeliveryCode, tm.name as materialName,tm.code as materialCode from t_material_detail_print a left join t_advance_delivery_detail b on a.advance_registration_id = b.id left join t_advance_delivery c on b.advance_delivery_id = c.id left join t_material tm on b.material_id = tm.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = a.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
a.del_flag = '0' and a.advance_registration_id = #{advanceRegistrationId}
and a.id = #{id} and a.print_count = #{printCount} and a.print_time = #{printTime} and a.min_unit = #{minUnit} and a.min_unit_name like concat('%', #{minUnitName}, '%')
and a.max_unit = #{maxUnit} and a.max_unit_name like concat('%', #{maxUnitName}, '%')
and a.convert_count = #{convertCount} and a.status = #{status} and b.batch_code like concat('%', #{batchCode}, '%')
and tm.code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%') and tm.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%') and `c`.code like concat('%', #{advanceDeliveryCode}, '%')
${params.dataScope} order by a.create_time desc
